description: This file is a Python script that serves as the front end for style-checker modules in the WebKit project, importing various style checkers, configuring logging, and dispatching style checks based on file types.

classes.name: FileType
classes.description: Enum-like class defining file type constants for style checking.

classes.name: CheckerDispatcher
classes.description: Class responsible for determining file types and dispatching appropriate style checkers based on file path and extension.

classes.name: StyleProcessorConfiguration
classes.description: Class storing configuration for style processing, including confidence levels, report limits, and output formatting.

classes.name: ProcessorBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for processing lines of code for style checking.

classes.name: StyleProcessor
classes.description: Concrete class for checking style in files, managing error counting, and handling style checks.

methods.name: should_process
methods.description: Determines if a file should be processed for style based on skip rules.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs style checking on given lines of a file, handling carriage returns and dispatching to specific checkers.
